about: A weekly comedy series about a fictional golf four-ball and friends, made from quick-cut photo sketches. Recurring characters, running gags, continuity and character development, funny outcomes. John asked for it on 21 Nov 2026.
rules: Banter, never bullying: jokes are about golf, never anyone's looks, weight, age or anything personal.
Everyone gets a win sometimes; whoever gets ribbed this week can land the last laugh next week.
Characters are fictional, never based on or resembling a real person, never presented as real golfers or real stories.
One clear punchline per episode, a funny outcome, 8 to 12 seconds, cut on the 0.6-second beat.
No character leads two episodes in a row; Kev's reactions rotate.
Real figures only: if an episode mentions prices, only true, general statements (e.g. last season's models usually cost less) or real figures from data/.
No words, logos or brands in photos; keep each character's look identical.

arcs.about: Gaz buys a new driver every few weeks; Kev keeps count. Payoff idea: Gaz finally finds his driver was fine all along, or buys last season's model for less and outdrives Kev.

Big Dave's creative scoring; Phil's props escalate (abacus, then calculator, then a referee's whistle, then the rule book). EP3: Phil brings the live scorecard as proof (the prop becomes our real tool).
Steady Steve keeps quietly winning with his 20-year-old irons while everyone else blames their kit. Payoff: the society cup.
Kev's own duffs get caught on camera; the group finally gets him back.
December: the society Christmas dinner and awards (Dave's speech, Phil's 'honest scorecard' award, Gaz's gift is a driver).

canon: EP1: Big Dave took six on a par 4 and called it a par. Phil offered him an abacus. Kev was in the background, trying not to laugh.
EP2: Gaz unboxed another new driver in the car park and sent his first drive into the trees. Kev: 'Must need a new driver.' Gaz: 'It's the shaft, mate.'
EP3: Big Dave claimed another par; Phil showed the live scorecard (six). Dave blamed the app. It's free, Dave.

gaz: Kev's favourite target; gives as good as he gets.
